'''Ultravisionary Taoism''' is a modern branch or trajectory of [[Taoism]] in the extracted source material.

The source presents it as an aggressive, technology-focused form of Taoist political thought. Because much of the source discusses advanced technologies and future-facing policy, this draft does not treat Ultravisionary Taoism as an established pre-1994 state ideology.

== Ideas ==

The source combines Taoist language of harmony and balance with technological acceleration, ecological modernization, expert-led governance, and international technology diplomacy.

Its economic program emphasizes advanced industrial systems, sustainable production, workforce development, and technical innovation. Its political model favors leaders selected for knowledge and expertise, especially in scientific and technical fields.

== Source Limits ==

The source does not provide a founding date, founder, first state, party, or confirmed pre-1994 movement. This page exists to preserve the later Taoist trajectory for review while preventing it from being retroactively inserted into the Xanaqu or Mariposian 1994-back chronology.
